rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reckoning is the Resurrection, when God will account people for their deeds.
rows.anchor: وقت محاسبة الله إياهم على أعمالهم. يعني: القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are heedless of preparing for that Day and turn away from faith.
rows.anchor: عن التأهب لذلك { معرضون } عن الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every newly revealed passage of the Qur’an is a reminder and admonition from God.
rows.anchor: ما يحدث الله تعالى من تنزيل شيء من القرآن يذكرهم ويعظهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They listen to the reminder while playing, meaning they mock it.
rows.anchor: { إلا استمعوه وهم يلعبون } يستهزئون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hearts are heedless, and they hold their conversation secretly among themselves.
rows.anchor: لاهية } غافلة { قلوبهم وأسروا النجوى } قالوا سرا فيما بينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers are the polytheists who made the secret claim that follows.
rows.anchor: الذين ظلموا } أشركوا، وهم أنهم قالوا:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They mean Muhammad, dismissing him as a human made of flesh and blood.
rows.anchor: هل هذا } يعنون محمدا { إلا بشر مثلكم } لحم ودم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By “sorcery” they mean the Qur’an, which they claim they recognize as sorcery.
rows.anchor: أفتأتون السحر } يريدون: إن القرآن سحر { وأنتم تبصرون } أنه سحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God disclosed their secret to the Prophet and says He knows speech in heaven and earth.
rows.anchor: فلما أطلع الله سبحانه نبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم على هذا السر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who take other gods must produce proof that anything besides God is worthy of worship.
rows.anchor: حجتكم على أن مع الله تعالى معبودا غيره

words: هذا ذكر من معي وذكر من قبلي
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an, Torah, and Gospel all teach God’s oneness; none supports another deity.
rows.anchor: { هذا ذكر من معي } يعني: القرآن { وذكر من قبلي } يعني: التوراة والإنجيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most do not know the truth because they fail to consider the proof of God’s oneness, and so turn away.
rows.anchor: فلا يتأملون حجة التوحيد، وهو قوله: { فهم معرضون }

words: وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every messenger before Muhammad called people to worship God alone; none taught that his community had another god.
rows.anchor: لم يبعث رسول إلا بتوحيد الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claimants are those who said that the angels are God’s daughters; the alleged child is from among the angels.
rows.anchor: الذين قالوا: الملائكة بنات الله، والمعنى وقالوا:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God declares Himself transcendent above the claim that He has a child.
rows.anchor: ثم نزه نفسه عما يقولون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels are honored servants, honored by God rather than His offspring.
rows.anchor: ثم نزه نفسه عما يقولون { بل } هم { عباد مكرمون } يعني: الملائكة مكرمون بإكرام الله إياهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true promise is the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: اقترب الوعد الحق } يعني: القيامة، والواو زائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wāw is extra, since “it has drawn near” answers ḥattā (“until”).
rows.anchor: والواو زائدة؛ لأن " اقترب " جواب " حتى "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their eyes stare fixedly and scarcely blink from the terror of that Day.
rows.anchor: ذاهبة لا تكاد تطرف من هول ذلك اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They confess that, in worldly life, they had been heedless of this Day.
rows.anchor: { يا ويلنا قد كنا في غفلة من هذا } في الدنيا عن هذا اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their wrongdoing consisted of associating partners with God and denying the messengers.
rows.anchor: ظالمين } بالشرك وتكذيب الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The objects worshipped alongside God are the idols.
rows.anchor: يعني: الأصنام { حصب جهنم } وقودها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are the fuel of Hell, and their worshippers will enter it.
rows.anchor: { حصب جهنم } وقودها { أنتم لها واردون } فيها داخلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the idols were truly gods, they would not enter the Fire.
rows.anchor: { لو كان هؤلاء } الأصنام { آلهة } على الحقيقة ما دخلوا النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both the worshippers and the idols will remain in the Fire forever.
rows.anchor: { وكل } من العابدين والمعبودين في النار { خالدون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It has been decreed for Satan that whoever follows him will be led astray and guided to the Blaze.
rows.anchor: كتب عليه } قضي على الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan calls his followers to the Fire by making falsehood attractive to them.
rows.anchor: يدعوه إلى النار بما يزين له من الباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people addressed are the unbelievers of Mecca.
rows.anchor: يا أيها الناس } يعني: كفار مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their doubt concerns being brought back to life.
rows.anchor: { إن كنتم في ريب من البعث } شك من الإعادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created humanity’s forefather, the origin of humankind, from soil.
rows.anchor: خلقناكم } خلقنا أباكم الذي أصل البشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ʿalaqa is congealed blood; the stages follow the creation of Adam’s descendants from a drop.
rows.anchor: ثم } خلقنا ذريته { من نطفة ثم من علقة } وهي الدم الجامد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A muḍgha is a small piece of flesh, about the amount one could chew.
rows.anchor: وهي لحمة قليلة قدر ما يمضغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The formed stage is complete in shape; the unformed stage is what the womb expels as blood, a miscarriage.
rows.anchor: مخلقة } مصورة تامة الخلق { وغير مخلقة } وهي ما تمجه الأرحام دما، يعني: السقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stages of human formation demonstrate the completeness of God’s power to shape creation.
rows.anchor: لنبين لكم } كمال قدرتنا بتصريفنا أطوار خلقكم

words: ونقر في الأرحام ما نشاء إلى أجل مسمى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God keeps in the womb what will not miscarry until the appointed time of birth.
rows.anchor: ونقر في الأرحام ما نشاء } ننزل فيها ما لا يكون سقطا { إلى أجل مسمى } إلى وقت خروجه

words: ثم نخرجكم طفلا ثم لتبلغوا أشدكم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brings people from their mothers’ wombs as infants, then they reach full intellect and strength.
rows.anchor: { ثم نخرجكم } من بطون الأمهات { طفلا } صغارا { ثم لتبلغوا أشدكم } عقولكم ونهاية قوتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some die before reaching full strength.
rows.anchor: ومنكم من يتوفى } يموت قبل بلوغ الأشد

words: يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others reach decrepit old age and senility, until they know nothing after having had knowledge.
rows.anchor: وهو الهرم والخرف حتى لا يعقل شيئا، وهو قوله: { لكيلا يعلم من بعد علم شيئا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth is dry, with bare soil.
rows.anchor: وترى الأرض هامدة } جافة ذات تراب

words: اهتزت وربت وأنبتت من كل زوج بهيج
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rain moves the earth with new growth, raises it, and brings forth every beautiful kind of plant as another sign of resurrection.
rows.anchor: { اهتزت } تحركت بالنبات { وربت } زادت { وأنبتت من كل زوج بهيج } من كل صنف حسن من النبات

words: إن الله يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God judges among the religious groups, admitting believers to Paradise and the others among them to the Fire.
rows.anchor: يحكم ويقضي، بأن يدخل المؤمنين الجنة، وغيرهم من هؤلاء الفرق النار

words: إن الله على كل شيء شهيد
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is witness in the sense that He knows what is in people’s hearts.
rows.anchor: يريد: إن الله عالم بما في قلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prostration here means being humbled before God and submitting to Him.
rows.anchor: يسجد له } يذل له، وينقاد له

words: من في السماوات ومن في الأرض والشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All things submit to God in their created state, provision, health, and sickness, whether righteous or sinful, believer or unbeliever.
rows.anchor: كل شيء منقاد لله عز وجل على ما خلقه، وعلى ما رزقه، وعلى ما أصحه وعلى ما أسقمه

words: وكثير من الناس وكثير حق عليه العذاب
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some people submit, while many others are subject to punishment.
rows.anchor: فالبر والفاجر، والمؤمن و الكافر في هذا سواء

words: ومن يهن الله فما له من مكرم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God humiliates someone through disbelief, no one else can honor that person.
rows.anchor: يذله بالكفر { فما له من مكرم } أحد يكرمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God humiliates whom He wills with disbelief and honors whom He wills with faith.
rows.anchor: يهين من يشاء بالكفر، ويكرم من يشاء بالإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God wards the harm of the polytheists away from the believers.
rows.anchor: إن الله يدفع } غائلة المشركين عن المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A khawwān betrays a trust, and a kafūr is ungrateful for God’s favor; these describe people who sacrifice to idols.
rows.anchor: خوان } في أمانته { كفور } لنعمته، وهم الذين تقربوا إلى الأصنام بذبائحهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This was the first verse revealed permitting jihad; believers were allowed to fight.
rows.anchor: يعني: المؤمنين، وهذه أول آية نزلت في الجهاد والمعنى: أذن لهم أن يقاتلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The permission to fight is because the unbelievers had wronged the believers.
rows.anchor: بظلم الكافرين إياهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God promises the believers victory.
rows.anchor: وعد من الله تعالى بالنصر

words: الذين أخرجوا من ديارهم بغير حق
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those expelled unjustly from their homes are the Emigrants.
rows.anchor: يعني: المهاجرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were driven out only because they professed God’s oneness.
rows.anchor: لم يخرجوا إلا بأن وحدوا الله تعالى

words: ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s restraining some people through others prevents the demolition of places of worship.
rows.anchor: لولا أن دفع الله بعض الناس ببعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The monasteries and churches named here belong to the era of Jesus.
rows.anchor: صوامع وبيع } في زمان عيسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ṣalawāt are the churches or synagogues of Moses’ law, called ṣalota in Aramaic.
rows.anchor: في أيام شريعة موسى عليه السلام، يعني: كنائسهم وهي بالعبرانية صلوتا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mosques named here belong to the law of Muhammad.
rows.anchor: في أيام شريعة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will help whoever supports His religion.
rows.anchor: من نصر دين الله نصره الله على ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is powerful over creation and invincible in His dominion.
rows.anchor: على خلقه { عزيز } منيع في سلطانه

words: لكل أمة جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every community has a religious law that its people follow.
rows.anchor: شريعة هم عاملون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse concerns people who disputed with believers, asking why they ate animals they slaughtered but not those God caused to die.
rows.anchor: نزلت في الذين جادلوا المؤمنين فقالوا: ما لكم تأكلون ما تقتلون، ولا تأكلون مما قتله الله؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they argue falsely and obstinately, answer that God knows their deeds of denial and unbelief.
rows.anchor: { وإن جادلوك } بباطلهم مراء وتعنتا فادفعهم بقولك: { الله أعلم بما تعملون } من التكذيب والكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their trusts include what has been entrusted to them in religious and worldly matters.
rows.anchor: ما ائتمنوا عليه من أمر الدين والدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They honor their covenants and oaths and fulfill them.
rows.anchor: وحلفهم الذي يوجد عليهم راعون، يرعون ذلك ويقومون بإتمامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They maintain their prayers by performing them at their appointed times.
rows.anchor: { والذين هم على صلواتهم يحافظون } بإدائها في مواقيتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The next verse explains what inheritance is meant: the inheritance of al-Firdaws.
rows.anchor: ثم ذكر ما يرثون فقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has made each person a house in Paradise; those who do the deeds of its people inherit that house, and Firdaws is the best of the gardens.
rows.anchor: جعل لكل امرىء بيتا في الجنة، فمن عمل عمل أهل الجنة ورث بيته في الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human being is from fluid extracted from Adam’s back; Adam himself was created from clay.
rows.anchor: من ماء سل واستخرج من ظهر آدم، وكان آدم عليه السلام خلق من طين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human is made a drop at the beginning of his formation.
rows.anchor: { ثم جعلناه } جعلنا الإنسان { نطفة } في أول بدو خلقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.
rows.anchor: في قرار مكين } يعني: الرحم. وقوله:

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported interpretation of the “another creation” is the distinction of male and female.
rows.anchor: قيل: يريد الذكورية والأنوثية

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported interpretation of the “another creation” is the breathing of the spirit.
rows.anchor: وقيل: يعني: نفخ الروح

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A further reported interpretation is the growth of hair and teeth.
rows.anchor: وقيل: نبات الشعر والأسنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God merits glorification and praise through the permanence of His existence.
rows.anchor: استحق التعظيم والثناء بدوام بقائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the best of those who form and determine creation.
rows.anchor: المصورين والمقدرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Fire sears their faces.
rows.anchor: { تلفح } تحرق. { وهم فيها كالحون } عابسون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They grimace because the burning contracts their lips.
rows.anchor: وهم فيها كالحون } عابسون لتقلص شفاههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are confronted with the fact that God’s signs were recited to them and they denied them.
rows.anchor: ألم تكن آياتي تتلى عليكم فكنتم بها تكذبون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They say that the wretchedness decreed for them overcame them.
rows.anchor: غلبت علينا شقوتنا } التي قضيت علينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They acknowledge their own misguidance.
rows.anchor: وكنا قوما ضالين } أقروا على أنفسهم بالضلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tastaʾnisū means to ask permission before entering.
rows.anchor: حتى تستأنسوا } تستأذنوا { وتسلموا على أهلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greeting is to say, “Peace be upon you; may I enter?”
rows.anchor: تسلموا على أهلها } وهو أن يقول: السلام عليكم، أأدخل؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If no one is there to permit entry, do not enter until permission is given.
rows.anchor: أحدا } يأذن لكم في دخولها { فلا تدخلوها حتى يؤذن لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If told to go back, leave rather than remain standing at the door.
rows.anchor: وإن قيل لكم ارجعوا } انصرفوا { فارجعوا } ولا تقفوا على أبوابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning is purer and better for the visitor.
rows.anchor: هو } أي: الرجوع { أزكى لكم } أطهر لكم وأصلح

words: بيوتا غير مسكونة فيها متاع لكم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the verse, someone asked the Prophet about unoccupied roadside inns and dwellings; this verse permitted entering such places without permission for a useful need or lodging.
rows.anchor: يا رسول الله، أفرأيت الخانات والمساكن في الطريق ليس فيها ساكن؟ فأنزل الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers must restrain their gaze from looking at what is unlawful.
rows.anchor: يكفوها عن النظر إلى ما لا يحل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must guard their private parts from what is unlawful; another explanation is that they cover them so they are not exposed.
rows.anchor: عن من لا يحل. وقيل: يستروها حتى لا تظهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The town showered with stones is the town of Lot’s people.
rows.anchor: يعني: الحجارة، وهي قرية قوم لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Meccan polytheists passed the town while traveling and should have taken a lesson from it.
rows.anchor: إذا مروا بها مسافرين فيعتبروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not fear a resurrection.
rows.anchor: لا يخافون بعثا

words: وإذا رأوك إن يتخذونك إلا هزوا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When they see Muhammad, they make him an object of ridicule.
rows.anchor: ما يتخذونك إلا مهزوءا به

rows.speaker: مشركي مكة
rows.claim: The Meccan polytheists mockingly ask whether this is the one God sent as a messenger to them.
rows.anchor: ويقولون: { أهذا الذي بعث الله رسولا } إلينا؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They say Muhammad nearly turned them away from worshipping their gods.
rows.anchor: فيصدنا عن عبادتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They claim that if they had not persevered in worshipping their idols, they would have abandoned them.
rows.anchor: لصرفنا عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They worshipped whatever their desire chose: if they saw a more attractive stone, they discarded the first idol for it.
rows.anchor: كانوا يعبدون شيئا حجرا، أو ما كان، فإذا رأوا حجرا أحسن طرحوا الأول وعبدوا الأحسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is not responsible for making such a person believe; his duty is only to deliver the message.
rows.anchor: حفيظا حتى ترده إلى الإيمان، أي: ليس عليك إلا التبليغ

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is also said that this verse was abrogated by the verse of the sword.
rows.anchor: وقيل: إن هذا مما نسخته آية السيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A “noble kind” is every praiseworthy type of plant that people need.
rows.anchor: من كل نوع محمود مما يحتاج إليه الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plants are a sign of God’s oneness and power.
rows.anchor: لدلالة على توحيد الله سبحانه وقدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most of them did not believe because God’s prior knowledge and decree had so determined.
rows.anchor: لما سبق في علمي وقضائي فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is told to recall when God called Moses on the night Moses saw the tree and the fire.
rows.anchor: { و } اذكر يا محمد { إذ نادى ربك موسى } ليلة رأى الشجرة والنار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people are wrongdoers against themselves through disbelief.
rows.anchor: القوم الظالمين } لأنفسهم بالكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is told to ask whether they will not fear God and believe in Him.
rows.anchor: ألا يخافون الله سبحانه فيؤمنوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-marjūmīn can mean those who are insulted; another reported meaning is those who are killed.
rows.anchor: أي: من المشتومين. وقيل: من المقتولين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Lot committed intercourse with men in their backsides.
rows.anchor: يريد: ما كان من فعل قوم لوط من إتيان الرجال في أدبارهم

words: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من أزواجكم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They leave their wives, whom God created for them, without having intercourse with them.
rows.anchor: وتدعون أن تأتوا نسائكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are transgressors who commit the utmost injustice.
rows.anchor: ظالمون غاية الظلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They threaten to drive Lot out of their town if he does not stop.
rows.anchor: عن بلدنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot says he detests their act of sodomy.
rows.anchor: إني لعملكم } يعني: اللواط { من القالين } من المبغضين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is seen when he stands for prayer.
rows.anchor: أي: إلى صلاتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His movement is through the prayer postures: standing, sitting, bowing, and prostrating.
rows.anchor: تصرفك في أركان الصلاة قائما وقاعدا، وراكعا، وساجدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The “prostrators” are the people performing prayer.
rows.anchor: في المصلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As recompense for their disbelief, God made their evil deeds seem good to them.
rows.anchor: جعلنا جزاءهم على كفرهم أن زينا لهم أعمالهم القبيحة حتى رأوها حسنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They wander in confusion.
rows.anchor: { فهم يعمهون } يتحيرون. { أولئك الذين لهم سوء العذاب }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their worldly punishment was being killed at Badr.
rows.anchor: في الدنيا القتل ببدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the afterlife they are losers because they are denied salvation and kept from the gardens.
rows.anchor: بحرمان النجاة، والمنع من الجنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an is conveyed to Muhammad as revelation from God.
rows.anchor: يلقى إليك القرآن وحيا من الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses was traveling from Midian toward Egypt with his family, lost the way, and saw a fire at a distance.
rows.anchor: في مسيرة من مدين إلى مصر، وقد ضل الطريق، وأصلد زنده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses hoped to learn the route from the fire.
rows.anchor: عن الطريق أين هو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A burning brand is a flame he could take for them so they could warm themselves.
rows.anchor: شعلة نار أقتبسها لكم { لعلكم تصطلون } تستدفئون من البرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The words refer to the one seeking and approaching the fire; the meaning is, “Blessed are you, Moses.”
rows.anchor: أي: من في طلب النار وقصدها، والمعنى: بورك فيك يا موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those around the fire are the angels.
rows.anchor: وفيمن حولها من الملائكة

words: بورك من في النار ومن حولها
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is God’s greeting to Moses and an honor bestowed on him.
rows.anchor: وهذا تحية من الله سبحانه لموسى وتكرمة له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase declares God free of every defect.
rows.anchor: تنزيها لله من السوء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff moves.
rows.anchor: تهتز } أي: تتحرك { كأنها جان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It resembles a quick, light snake.
rows.anchor: كأنها جان } حية خفيفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses ran away and neither returned nor looked back.
rows.anchor: ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب } ولم يرجع ولم يلتفت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception concerns one who wronged himself but then repented.
rows.anchor: إلا من ظلم } لكن من ظلم نفسه { ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء } أي: تاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is forgiving and merciful to the repentant person.
rows.anchor: ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء } أي: تاب { فإني غفور رحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is sent with nine signs.
rows.anchor: أي: من تسع آيات أنت مرسل بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mission is directed to Pharaoh and his people.
rows.anchor: تسع آيات أنت مرسل بها. { إلى فرعون وقومه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs were bright and clear.
rows.anchor: مبصرة } أي: مضيئة واضحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They denied the signs out of injustice and arrogance even though they knew they came from God.
rows.anchor: وجحدوا بها ظلما وترفعا عن أن يؤمنوا بما جاء به موسى وهم يعلمون أنها من عند الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Queen sends the gift to appease and test Solomon: a king would accept it, while a prophet would not.
rows.anchor: أصانعه بها وأختبره أملك هو أم نبي؟ فإن كان ملكا قبلها، وإن كان نبيا لم يقبلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She waits to see what response her messengers bring back.
rows.anchor: فناظرة بم } بأي شيء { يرجع المرسلون } من عنده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon rejects the offer because God gave him religion, prophethood, and wisdom, better than their worldly goods.
rows.anchor: فما آتاني الله } من الدين والنبوة والحكمة { خير مما آتاكم } من الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They rejoice in gifts because they compete for worldly abundance.
rows.anchor: لأنهم أهل مكاثرة بالدنيا

words: فلنأتينهم بجنود لا قبل لهم بها
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon threatens them with an army they cannot withstand and says he will expel them in humiliation.
rows.anchor: فلنأتينهم بجنود لا قبل لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the messenger reported what he saw, the Queen prepared to travel to Solomon.
rows.anchor: فجاءها الرسول وأخبرها بما رأى وشاهد، فتجهزت للمسير إلى سليمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon wants the throne before they submit, because taking what is in their possession would then be unlawful.
rows.anchor: لأنه حينئذ لا يحل أخذ ما في أيديهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One explanation says the revelation to Moses’ mother was inspiration.
rows.anchor: قيل: إنه وحي إلهام

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation says the revelation was notification.
rows.anchor: وحي إلهام. وقيل: وحي إعلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s household took Moses from the water; the outcome was that he became their enemy and grief.
rows.anchor: { فالتقطه } أخذه { آل فرعون } عن الماء { ليكون لهم عدوا وحزنا } أي: ليصير الأمر إلى ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh, Haman, and their troops were disobedient and sinful.
rows.anchor: إن فرعون وهامان وجنودهما كانوا خاطئين } أي: عاصين آثمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s wife says Moses is a delight to her and Pharaoh and asks them not to kill him, since the water brought him from elsewhere and he is not an Israelite.
rows.anchor: { وقالت امرأة فرعون قرة عين } أي: هو قرة عين لي { ولك لا تقتلوه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not realize what will come to pass for them and for Moses.
rows.anchor: بما هو كائن من أمرهم وأمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses’ mother’s heart was empty of everything except remembering and worrying about him.
rows.anchor: خاليا عن كل شيء إلا عن ذكر موسى وهمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She nearly disclosed that Moses was her son.
rows.anchor: إن كادت لتبدي به } بأنه ابنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God strengthened her heart and inspired her to be patient so she would believe His promise.
rows.anchor: لولا أن ربطنا على قلبها } قوينا قلبها وألهمناها الصبر { لتكون من المؤمنين

words: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌۭ مِّنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man who came running from the far end of the city was the believer from Pharaoh’s household.
rows.anchor: وجاء رجل من أقصى المدينة يسعى } وهو مؤمن آل فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were consulting together and telling one another to kill Moses.
rows.anchor: يأمر بعضهم بعضا يتشاورون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man advises Moses to leave that city, saying he is giving sincere advice.
rows.anchor: فاخرج } من هذه المدينة { إني لك من الناصحين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses left afraid and expecting pursuit.
rows.anchor: فخرج منها خائفا يترقب } ينتظر الطلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oppressive people from whom Moses seeks rescue are Pharaoh’s people.
rows.anchor: قال رب نجني من القوم الظالمين } قوم فرعون

words: ربي أعلم بمن جاء بالهدى من عنده
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says God knows that he himself brought guidance from God.
rows.anchor: يعني: نفسه، أي: ربي أعلم بي أن الذي جئت به من عنده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good final outcome is the praiseworthy end in the Hereafter.
rows.anchor: العقبى المحمودة في الدار الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh orders Haman to bake bricks from clay.
rows.anchor: فأوقد لي يا هامان على الطين } أي: اطبخ لي الآجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A ṣarḥ is a tall, elevated building.
rows.anchor: بناء طويلا مشرفا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh says he wants to look at and stand above Moses’ God.
rows.anchor: أنظر إليه وأقف عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers are told to call upon the beings they worshipped besides God.
rows.anchor: من كنتم تعبدون من دون الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols give them no reply that can benefit them.
rows.anchor: لم يجيبوهم بشيء ينفعهم

words: ورأوا العذاب لو أنهم كانوا يهتدون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had they been guided, they would not have followed the idols and would not have seen the punishment.
rows.anchor: لما اتبعوهم ولما رأوا العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their arguments become obscure to them because God had already given them full warning in worldly life, leaving them no excuse.
rows.anchor: عميت عليهم الحجج؛ لأن الله تعالى قد أعذر إليهم في الدنيا، فلا تكون لهم حجة يومئذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They fall silent and do not ask one another what arguments they might offer.
rows.anchor: لا يسأل بعضهم بعضا عما يحتجون به

words: وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seek the Hereafter by spending the wealth God gave you in ways that please Him.
rows.anchor: اطلبها بإنفاق مالك في رضا الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not neglect to work in worldly life for the sake of your Hereafter.
rows.anchor: لا تترك أن تعمل في دنياك لآخرتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do good to other people as God has done good to you.
rows.anchor: إلى الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Corruption here means committing sins.
rows.anchor: العمل بالمعاصي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qarun claims that his knowledge makes him deserving of his wealth; he was the most learned Israelite in the Torah.
rows.anchor: على فضل علم عندي، وكنت بذلك العلم مسحقا لفضل المال، وكان أقرأ بني إسرائيل للتوراة

words: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God had destroyed earlier generations stronger than Qarun and greater in amassed wealth.
rows.anchor: من هو أشد منه قوة وأكثر جمعا } للمال منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The criminals enter the Fire without being called to account.
rows.anchor: لأنهم يدخلون النار بغير حساب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They fabricate a lie by claiming that idols are partners of God.
rows.anchor: أي: تقولون كذبا: إن الأوثان شركاء الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation is that they cut off the possibility of having children; another says they seize travelers on the road to solicit sexual immorality.
rows.anchor: أي: سبيل الولد. وقيل: يأخذون الناس من الطرق لطلب الفاحشة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their wrongdoing in their gathering was that they had intercourse with one another.
rows.anchor: في ناديكم } مجلسكم { المنكر } كان بعضهم يجامع بعضا في مجالسهم

words: فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His people answer by demanding the punishment he says will come upon them.
rows.anchor: قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله إن كنت من الصادقين } أنه نازل بنا

words: إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer contains restraint and deterrence from disobeying God; whoever is not deterred by prayer has not truly prayed.
rows.anchor: في الصلاة منهاة ومزدجرا عن معاصي الله تعالى، فمن لم تنهه صلاته عن المنكر فليست صلاته بصلاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God is greater than everything in worldly life and more excellent.
rows.anchor: من كل شيء في الدنيا وأفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Debate the People of the Book with gracious speech that invites them to God and points out proofs.
rows.anchor: وهو الجميل من القول بالدعاء إلى الله عز وجل، والتنبيه على الحجج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is for those among them who wronged the Muslims by fighting them or withholding the jizya.
rows.anchor: إلا الذين ظلموكم بالقتال ومنع الجزية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given scripture before Muhammad’s time believed in him because they found his description in their books; some of his contemporaries also believe in him.
rows.anchor: من كانوا قبل عصره كانوا يؤمنون به لما يجدونه من نعته في كتابهم

words: وما كنت تتلوا من قبله من كتاب ولا تخطه بيمينك
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad had not read or written a book before the Qur’an; otherwise opponents could doubt him and accuse him of composing it from a book.
rows.anchor: من كتاب ولا تخطه } ولا تكتبه { بيمينك إذا لارتاب المبطلون } لشكوا فيك واتهموك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The “people of falsehood” here are the unbelievers of Quraysh.
rows.anchor: وأراد بالمبطلين كفار قريش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God lets them enjoy worldly life for a short time.
rows.anchor: نمتعهم قليلا } بالدنيا { ثم نضطرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Then God compels them to a severe punishment.
rows.anchor: ثم نضطرهم } نلجئهم { إلى عذاب غليظ

words: من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If asked who created the heavens and earth, they acknowledge that it was God.
rows.anchor: ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموات والأرض ليقولن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise God, who created the heavens and earth.
rows.anchor: الذي خلقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They show their ignorance by associating partners with God after acknowledging that He created the heavens and earth.
rows.anchor: إذ أشركوا به بعد إقرارهم بأنه خالقهما

words: ولو أن ما في الأرض من شجرة أقلام
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The polytheists claimed the Qur’an’s speech would run out; God answers that His words are inexhaustible.
rows.anchor: وذلك أن المشركين قالوا في القرآن: هذا كلام سينفذ وينقطع، فأعلم الله سبحانه أن كلامه لا ينفد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sea is increased by more water, and God’s words are then written with it.
rows.anchor: أي: يزيد فيه، ثم كتبت به كلمات الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even with every tree as pens and the seas as ink, God’s words would not be exhausted.
rows.anchor: ثم كتبت به كلمات الله { ما نفدت }

words: ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم إلا كنفس واحدة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating and resurrecting all people is like creating and resurrecting one person, since God has equal power over both.
rows.anchor: أي: كخلق وكبعث نفس واحدة؛ لأن قدرة الله سبحانه على بعث الخلق كقدرته على بعث نفس واحدة

words: يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God causes night to enter day and day to enter night, and has subjected the sun and moon, each running to an appointed term.
rows.anchor: وأن الله بما تعملون خبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God did these things so people would know that He is the Real, with no deity but Him.
rows.anchor: { ذلك } أي: فعل الله ذلك لتعلموا { بأن الله هو الحق } الذي لا إله غيره

words: إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those described as patient and grateful are believers with these qualities.
rows.anchor: أي: لكل مؤمن بهذه الصفة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported view identifies the lesser punishment as worldly calamities.
rows.anchor: قيل: المصيبات في الدنيا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported view identifies it as the killing at Badr.
rows.anchor: وقيل: القتل ببدر

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported view identifies it as the punishment of the grave.
rows.anchor: وقيل: عذاب القبر

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported view identifies it as seven years of famine.
rows.anchor: وقيل: الجوع سبع سنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preferred interpretation is worldly calamities together with famine, because these may lead people to return to God.
rows.anchor: والأولى المصيبات والجوع لقوله: { لعلهم يرجعون }

words: فلا تكن في مرية من لقائه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The meeting is Moses’ meeting with Muhammad on the night of the heavenly ascent; God promised Muhammad he would see Moses during the Night Journey.
rows.anchor: فلا تكن في مرية من لقائه } أي: من لقاء موسى عليه السلام ليلة المعراج، وعده الله تعالى أن يريه موسى عليه السلام ليلة الإسراء به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The leaders are from the Children of Israel and guide people by God’s command.
rows.anchor: وجعلنا منهم } من بني إسرائيل { أئمة } قادة { يهدون } يدعون الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They became leaders because they remained patient upon the truth.
rows.anchor: بأمرنا لما صبروا } حين صبروا على الحق

words: إن ربك هو يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God judges between those who denied Muhammad concerning their disagreement about his message.
rows.anchor: { إن ربك هو يفصل } يحكم { بينهم يوم القيامة } بين المكذبين بك { فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون } من أمرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The destruction of earlier peoples who denied messengers should have made Muhammad’s opponents recognize his truth.
rows.anchor: أو لم يهد لهم } يتبين لهم صدقك { كم أهلكنا } إهلاكنا من كذب الرسل منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Travelers pass through and see the ruined dwellings of those earlier peoples.
rows.anchor: إذا سافروا، فيرون خراب منازلهم

words: إن في ذلك لآيات أفلا يسمعون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These ruins are signs and admonitions that they should hear.
rows.anchor: آيات الله وعظاته

words: ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفه
rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The verse refutes an unbeliever who claimed that two hearts let him understand more than Muhammad; it is said to have been Ibn Khaṭal.
rows.anchor: إن لي قلبين أفهم بكل واحد منهما أكثر مما يفهم محمد، فأكذبه الله تعالى. قيل: إنه ابن خطل

words: وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى تُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zihār does not make a wife a mother in the prohibited sense; it was a pre-Islamic form of divorce for which God prescribed expiation.
rows.anchor: لم يجعل نساءكم اللائي تقولون: هن علينا كظهور أمهاتنا في الحرام كما تقولون، وكان هذا من طلاق الجاهلية، فجعل الله في ذلك كفارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adopted children are not biological sons; words alone do not make someone a son, since God’s truth is that a non-son is not a son.
rows.anchor: من تبنيتموه { أبناءكم } في الحقيقة كما تقولون { ذلكم قولكم بأفواهكم } قول بالفم لا حقيقة له { والله يقول الحق } وهو أن غير الابن لا يكون ابنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The way God guides is the straight way.
rows.anchor: وهو يهدي السبيل } أي: السبيل المستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adopted children should be attributed to the fathers who begot them; this is more just before God.
rows.anchor: { ادعوهم لآبائهم } أي: انسبوهم إلى الذين ولدوهم { هو أقسط عند الله } أعدل عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If their fathers are unknown, they are brothers in religion and your mawālī, meaning paternal cousins.
rows.anchor: { فإن لم تعلموا آباءهم } من هم { فإخوانكم في الدين } أي فهم إخوانكم في الدين { ومواليكم } وبنو عمكم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation of mawālī is your allies in religion.
rows.anchor: وبنو عمكم. وقيل: أولياؤكم في الدين

words: وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم به
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no blame for an inadvertent form of address, such as calling someone “my son” without intending inheritance as if he were a biological child; blame attaches to what the heart intends.
rows.anchor: وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم به } وهو ن يقول لغير ابنه: يا بني

words: إن الله وملائكته يصلون على النبي
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s ṣalāt is His praise and mercy for the Prophet, while the angels’ ṣalāt is their supplication for him.
rows.anchor: الله تعالى يثني على النبي ويرحمه، والملائكة يدعون له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers are to say, “O God, bless Muhammad and grant him peace.”
rows.anchor: قولوا: اللهم صل على محمد وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who harm God and His Messenger include Jews, Christians, and polytheists who made blasphemous claims about God, Christ, and the angels.
rows.anchor: يعني: اليهود والنصارى والمشركين في قولهم:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was also physically attacked, and called a sorcerer and poet.
rows.anchor: وشجوا وجه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقالوا له: ساحر وشاعر

words: يؤذون المؤمنين والمؤمنات بغير ما اكتسبوا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They harm believing men and women by accusing them of deeds they did not commit.
rows.anchor: { والذين يؤذون المؤمنين والمؤمنات بغير ما اكتسبوا } يرمونهم بغير ما عملوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Men seeking sexual access followed women at night and sought slave women; free women and slaves wore the same clothes, so God ordered free women to distinguish themselves with their outer wraps and avoid harassment.
rows.anchor: كان قوم من الزناة يتبعون النساء إذا خرجن ليلا، ولم يكونوا يطلبون إلا الإماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should let down their outer garments and wraps so they are recognized as free women and are not molested.
rows.anchor: أي: يرخين أرديتهن وملاحفهن؛ ليعلم أنهن حرائر فلا يتعرض لهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forgives their earlier failure to cover and shows mercy by providing them this covering.
rows.anchor: لما سلف من ترك الستر { رحيما } بهن إذ يسترهن
